name: GridRowClassNameParams
description: Object passed as parameter in the row `getRowClassName` callback prop.

entries.name: row
entries.description: The row model of the row that the current cell belongs to.

entries.name: isFirstVisible
entries.description: Whether this row is the first visible or not.

entries.name: isLastVisible
entries.description: Whether this row is the last visible or not.

entries.name: indexRelativeToCurrentPage
entries.description:
Index of the row in the current page.
If the pagination is disabled, it will be the index relative to all filtered rows.
